Overview.Name: Gandla Anusha
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (120 g) lightly pan fried + cucumber slices
Option 2: Thick curd bowl + small fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_4 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Keep food simple, less spicy and avoid fried items to reduce inflammation.
Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice.
Maintain a fixed routine daily to support recovery.
For stress eating, pause and drink water or buttermilk before eating extra.
Consistent meals will help improve energy and reduce flare-ups over time.
